verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page states that users can "review large diffs with ease, view third-party code reports, and open Jira tickets right from the PR screen," which matches the story directly. That claim is the only support: a short marketing statement with no in-depth documentation or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how large diffs are handled in review, specifics on which third-party report providers surface in the PR screen and how, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
